title: Short Encoding of Words
summary: Determine the minimum length of a reference string s that encodes an array of words using indices.
statement: Determine the minimum length of a reference string s that encodes an array of words using indices. The reference string s must end with a '#' and include substrings of words starting from each index in the indices array, up to the next '#'. The goal is to minimize the total length of s.
constraints: Encode words as suffixes of # terminated strings and return minimum total reference length.
hints: A word costs no extra space exactly when it is a suffix of another retained word.
Start with unique words and discard every proper suffix.
For each word discard word[i:] for i>=1; sum len+1 of survivors.
Every discarded word can point inside a survivor, while no survivor can share a terminating reference as another word’s suffix.
editorial: Every discarded word can point inside a survivor, while no survivor can share a terminating reference as another word’s suffix.

tests.explanation: Me is a suffix of time, so time#bell# has length ten.
The encoding t# has length two.
